title: Test fix: test_tally_gates_day_and_window_independently assumes "three hours ago is still today" and fails between 00:00 and 03:00 local time; pin the test clock to a fixed midday timestamp so the suite is green at any hour
spec:
Goal T-0489 on goal/T-0489. Work only in your own worktree and commit only on your own branch. Fact: tests/test_pool.py PlannerTally.test_tally_gates_day_and_window_independently (around line 405) sets three_h_ago = self.now - 3 * 3600 with the comment "still today, but before window_started"; self.now is the real current time, so between 00:00 and 03:00 Europe/Zurich the three-hours-ago timestamp falls on the previous day and planner_day_tokens is 0 instead of 15 (observed 2026-09-21 00:04 on goal/T-0445 head 4149f67 and on task/T-0493; the merge of T-0493 went tests_red on it). pool.py derives the day with datetime.fromtimestamp(now, tz=TZ) (pool.py:46, 451) and date.today() elsewhere.
1. In PlannerTally.setUp (or in that test), derive self.now from a fixed local-midday timestamp for the test's day (for example datetime(2026, 9, 15, 12, 0, tzinfo=TZ).timestamp()) and pass that now= into every tally call the class makes, so "three hours ago" is always the same day; if other PlannerTally tests rely on the real clock, keep their behaviour but make this one hermetic. Do not change pool.py.
2. Add a test test_tally_day_boundary_three_hours_before_midnight_counts_yesterday that pins now to 00:30 local and asserts the three-hours-ago line is NOT counted for today (documenting the intended semantics).
Full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exit 0 in the worktree regardless of the wall clock; commit with the task id including the named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: tests/test_pool.py::test_tally_gates_day_and_window_independently passes at any hour (pinned clock) and tests/test_pool.py::test_tally_day_boundary_three_hours_before_midnight_counts_yesterday passes
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree; the commit is on this task's own branch
